opinions.snippet:
Justice GINSBURG delivered the opinion of the Court.
 

  Bobby James Moore fatally shot a store clerk during a botched robbery. He was convicted of capital murder and sentenced to death. Moore challenged his death sentence on the ground that he was intellectually disabled and therefore exempt from execution.
